units.source_text: “如果仅仅只是一点还没法安宁。

en.t: If it were only that one thing, I still could not be at peace.

units.source_text: 我的身体健康，拥有一辈子花不完的财产。

en.t: I am healthy, and I have more wealth than I could spend in a lifetime.

units.source_text: 不过我觉得，我最幸福的一点是生下来的时候是个老头子。”

en.t: But I think the happiest thing of all is that I was born an old man.
